exam_scheme.note: AP ICET is conducted as a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) of 150 minutes duration comprising 200 multiple-choice questions across three sections: Analytical Ability, Communication Ability, and Mathematical Ability. Each question carries 1 mark with no negative marking. Qualifying mark is 25% (50 out of 200) for OC/BC candidates; no minimum qualifying mark for SC/ST.

stages.source_label: APSCHE & Andhra University — AP ICET 2026 Instruction Booklet & Test Pattern

papers.qualifying_threshold: 25% aggregate across all sections (50 out of 200) for OC/BC candidates; no minimum for SC/ST

papers.qualifying_threshold: 25% aggregate across all sections (50 out of 200) for OC/BC candidates; no minimum for SC/ST

competition_benchmarks.note: Applicant registration and appearance counts are released officially by APSCHE and the convener university following result declarations. As a university admission entrance exam for MBA and MCA courses, seats are allocated based on college counseling rather than civil vacancies; selectivity reflects the qualified-to-appeared candidate ratio.
